# nomatron_agent_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Rotate and return a fresh Nomatron agent token without storing it in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "nomatron_agent_token" "example" {
  agent_id        = nomatron_agent.example.id
  name            = "terraform"
  revoke_existing = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent ID to rotate a token for.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC3339 expiration timestamp for the minted token.
- `name` (String) Optional display name for the minted token.
- `revoke_existing` (Boolean) Whether existing tokens should be revoked as part of rotation.

### Read-Only

- `revoked_tokens` (Number) Number of tokens revoked during rotation.
- `rotated_at` (String) Timestamp when rotation occurred.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The newly minted raw token.
- `token_id` (String) The minted token ID.
- `token_prefix` (String) Prefix for the minted token.
